care_path.title: Shoulder pain that came on gradually, often with painful clicking

tic_bcbs_ma_hmo_blue_fi.publisher: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Massachusetts · HMO Blue (fully insured)

tic_bcbs_ma_hmo_blue_si.publisher: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Massachusetts · HMO Blue (self insured)

lines.plain_name: Visit with your main doctor first (at your primary care office)
lines.why: Some plans, especially HMO plans, won't pay for a specialist unless your main doctor sends a referral first.

cell.what: your primary care office's fee for the referral visit: we do not know which office you use, and no primary care offices are in our list yet

lines.plain_name: Visit with a bone & joint doctor
lines.why: The exam narrows down which part of the shoulder is the problem, and that decides which test, if any, comes next.

lines.plain_name: Quick picture of the shoulder bones
lines.why: Guidelines rate an X-ray as the first test for shoulder pain that has lasted a while. It shows arthritis, bone spurs and calcium in the tendons, which changes what comes next.

lines.plain_name: Guided exercise program for the shoulder
lines.why: Exercise therapy helps many tendon problems, including some tears, and is usually tried before any detailed scan.

lines.plain_name: Later exercise sessions (each 15 minutes)
lines.why: Exercise therapy helps many tendon problems, including some tears, and is usually tried before any detailed scan.

lines.plain_name: Shot of anti-inflammatory and numbing medicine
lines.why: It can calm the pain for a while so you can do your exercises. Guidelines say a single shot can be considered for short-term relief.

lines.plain_name: The medicine in the shot
lines.why: The medicine in the shot may appear as its own line on the bill.

cell.what: the price of the medicine itself (we do not read drug codes from the price files yet)

lines.plain_name: Live sound-wave picture of the tendons
lines.why: If the X-ray looks normal and the pain continues, this shows whether a tendon is torn and how big the tear is.

lines.plain_name: Detailed scan of tendons & cartilage
lines.why: If the X-ray looks normal and the pain continues, this shows tendon tears and cartilage damage in detail.

lines.plain_name: Detailed scan with dye in the joint
lines.why: The dye seeps into small tears, so it shows damage to the cartilage rim around the socket (the labrum) better. It's used when clicking comes with catching or a slipping feeling.

lines.plain_name: Detailed scan with dye in the joint: an extra part (Injection for shoulder arthrography)
lines.why: The dye seeps into small tears, so it shows damage to the cartilage rim around the socket (the labrum) better. It's used when clicking comes with catching or a slipping feeling.

cell.what: this code's price: we do not read it from insurer files yet

lines.plain_name: Detailed scan with dye in the joint: an extra part (Fluoroscopic needle guidance)
lines.why: The dye seeps into small tears, so it shows damage to the cartilage rim around the socket (the labrum) better. It's used when clicking comes with catching or a slipping feeling.

cell.what: this code's price: we do not read it from insurer files yet
